value.rationale: An infinite sequence of exact, transverse double maximal localization eigenvalues for nontrivial disconnected finite-area observation regions resolves a structural multiplicity phenomenon affecting uniqueness of optimally concentrated signals. The explicit geometric-phase radii, distinct symmetry-sector crossing and persistence under small positive disk width are natural and substantive; no general classification or uniform disk-size bound is asserted.
